Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), if so, Gloria Novi Saeculi issue of Arles mint, 367-375, encrusted, possibly from inclusion in a hoard, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped right. Obverse inscription: [---]RA[--]. Reverse description: Encrusted, I in right field. Reverse inscription: [--]O[---]CVL[--]. Diameter: 19.1mm, Weight: 2.17gms, die axis: 6
